title: Periyar University Schools & Departments
description: An organized, responsive academic web experience that makes university schools and department information easier to explore.
overview: Designed and developed the official Schools & Departments portal for Periyar University. The platform provides a structured, responsive interface for students, faculty, and visitors to explore academic departments, faculty directories, research facilities, and program curricula with real-time academic database connectivity.
highlights: Full-stack coordination in a university website project

title: PG Entrance Examination Portal
description: A web application for postgraduate entrance examination workflows within Periyar University's Department of Computer Science.
overview: The Postgraduate Entrance Examination Portal was developed for the Department of Computer Science at Periyar University. It handles candidate registration, hall ticket verification, timed examination delivery, and automated score computation with robust security against session tampering.
highlights: Instant result computation and administrative reporting

title: Ph.D Entrance Examination Portal
description: An entrance examination interface built for doctoral admissions, with a focused candidate-facing user experience.
overview: Designed and developed for Periyar University's doctoral admissions program. The portal coordinates online candidate verification, secure question paper rendering, timed test sessions, and centralized result evaluation for university-wide admissions.
highlights: Isolated examination sessions with anti-tamper controls
Scalable question bank and answer processing
Administrative dashboard for marks entry and rank listing

title: University Election Management Console
description: An administrative dashboard interface for managing university election related workflows and records.
overview: Developed for the Department of Computer Science, Periyar University. The console automates student council election administration, voter registration validation, confidential digital ballot casting, and real-time tally publishing with cryptographic single-vote verification.
highlights: Live tally monitoring and audit reports

title: Mentor–Mentee Management System
description: A university-facing portal designed to support structured mentor–mentee academic coordination.
overview: A centralized academic coordination tool connecting faculty mentors with student mentees in the Department of Computer Science. Facilitates performance tracking, counseling sessions, academic progress logs, semester reviews, and placement readiness tracking.
highlights: Continuous student academic tracking & attendance notes

title: LifeDrop AI — Blood Donation Concept
description: A health technology concept exploring better digital experiences for connecting blood donors with people who need help.
overview: An innovative digital healthcare prototype connecting blood donors, hospital blood banks, and emergency recipients through AI matching and geo-proximity search. Includes an audit trail concept and bilingual English/Tamil interface.
highlights: Transparent audit trail concept for blood safety
Progressive Web App (PWA) with responsive mobile UI
